references.shows: Mamadou Kouyaté's 21-string kora shows the long neck with braided leather tuning collars, calabash, paired handles, and tall bridge.
The neutral museum photograph shows the hide fasteners, hemispherical calabash and its proportions relative to the neck. Several strings are missing.
A stringing demonstration explains and illustrates how strings pass through notches on both sides of the bridge and onto leather neck collars.
The construction diagram after Tiémoko Sissokho identifies the parallel handles, perpendicular bridge and its pad, side sound opening, and common tail ring.

silhouette: An upright three-quarter view, with a long neck above the skin-covered gourd, a tall projecting bridge and a pair of wooden handgrips framing the string fan.
features: Rounded gourd bowl with a small side opening and a light hide face secured by a ring of perimeter fasteners
Long through-neck with twenty-one leather tuning collars and a tail ring below the resonator
Tall narrow notched bridge standing out from a pad on the skin face
Twenty-one fine strings form two banks of eleven and ten with staggered notches, and continue below the bridge to the tail ring
Two slender parallel handgrips with rounded ends rise above the near and far edges of the hide face
iconFeatures: Round calabash beneath a long, nearly upright neck
One open string triangle reaching a projecting bridge, flanked by two short grip silhouettes
avoid: A neck lying across the canvas in the pose of a guitar
All strings converging on a single point on the bridge
Frets or guitar-style tuning keys on this leather-collar model
notes: A traditional leather-collar Mandinka kora. The Met specimen guides the overall height-to-width ratio, the Cleveland photo shows the hide-rim construction, and the diagram clarifies the working bridge, grips and tail ring.

geometry.view: Upright three-quarter from the skin-facing side, with one flank of the gourd visible
geometry.proportions: The long narrow neck and collar run extend above the gourd for more than half the total height. The broad gourd remains nearly circular in projection.
geometry.partLayout: The neck passes behind the hide and reappears below the bowl. Both banks fan in front of the neck toward staggered bridge notches, then approach the tail ring. The grips flank the bridge.

documentedDimensions.value: 115.8 cm tall × 52.5 cm wide, about 2.2:1 overall
